title: Vampire Vape Rhubarb & Custard Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Delight in the whimsical fusion of Vampire Vape’s Rhubarb and Custard e-liquid, a nostalgic candy-inspired blend that marries the tangy zest of rhubarb with the velvety sweetness of creamy custard. This enchanting concoction perfectly recreates the cherished confectionery treat, delivering a truly delectable vaping experience. Relish the playful balance of sharp rhubarb notes and the indulgent richness of custard as they come together to form a tantalising and harmonious flavour profile. Ideal for those seeking a trip down memory lane or a touch of sweet indulgence, Rhubarb and Custard promises to captivate your senses and evoke fond memories with every puff. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based 0mg E-liquid Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Mix your own e-liquids, just the way you like Made in the UK
